name: Pipeliners - Project Guide (CLAUDE.md)
body:
> Guide · Pipeliners · 2026-10-10

# Summary
The project CLAUDE.md that Claude Code loads in the Pipeliners folder. It points to the Session Handoff (history and status) and the Company Master Profile (facts and claims), and says to verify live before any "what's pending" answer because the site changes between sessions. Files were reorganized 2026-10-01 (nothing deleted); the old-to-new path log is the shared Organization Log.

# Client basics
Pipeliners (say "Pipeliners" only), 633 W 2nd Ave, Mesa. Owner Scott Vincent, Jake approves claims. Services, not-offered list and verified claims match [Pipeliners - Company Profile](lib:brain-pipeliners-company-profile).

# Site and tool access (references, no credentials)
- **WordPress:** Hostinger via SSH alias `pipeliners`; WP root `/home/u916326661/domains/pipelinersusa.com/public_html`; always pass `--path` (7 sites on the host); DB prefix `wpku_`; WP-CLI `--user=7`; PHP `exec()` disabled; site timezone UTC.
- **Stack:** pixfort Essentials theme, Elementor 4.2.1 free (city and service pages), Gutenberg for most blogs, LiteSpeed Cache, MetaSync (Search Atlas OTTO). Rank Math is deactivated.
- **OTTO owns live titles, meta, H1s, schema and image alts.** Project 9905 (UUID ca42c443...), site audit 41385, KRT 34164, GBP location 7809, LLMV e3c7ba8e. Crawl set to Never since Aug 25. OTTO does not discover new posts, so mu-plugin `pipeliners-post-seo-meta.php` sets new-post titles and metas. Refresh one URL at a time (`~/bocheck.php`, `~/warm_one.php`).
- **Key mu-plugins:** redirects (301 map), FAQ schema, article schema, archive and LP noindex, hidden-OTTO-block strippers, hero image alt, featured image, author avatar. Each is reversible by deleting the file and purging.
- **GSC:** domain property via Kim's Chrome; Search Atlas `gsc_*` tools read the URL-prefix property and drop anonymized queries.
- **Google Ads:** customer 7219095860 under MCC 805-257-4115, read-only.
- **GHL:** location `EiTihyrdd2j8bFW4xpe2`; tokens live in the GHL .env and are never copied.
- **Keystone CRM:** Kim signs in; Claude never enters passwords.
- **Higgsfield:** Arizona-looking images only, 4-inch residential scale, no logos or text.

# Recurring workflows
- Monday 8am scheduled task `pipeliners-change-tracker-weekly` refreshes the SEO Results Scorecard from the GSC Domain UI.
- Safe live edit recipe (ad check, re-read, backup to post meta and `fix-backups\`, guarded dry run, clear Elementor caches, refresh one URL, verify desktop and Googlebot mobile, log in the change log CSV).
- OTTO edits scoped by url_id, never deploy all.
- GSC Request Indexing in Kim's Chrome, stop at "Quota Exceeded".
- New blog workflow (keyword pool, draft, approval, Gutenberg build with quick answer, takeaways, table, FAQ accordion and FAQ JSON-LD, 1600x774 card, mu-plugin meta, 2 inbound links, request indexing).
- Local pages from Oct 10: `/restructure-local-page` (structure only) and `/rebuild-local-page` (new copy), reference build /avondale/. See [Pipeliners - Workflow Skills](lib:brain-pipeliners-workflow-skills).
- Monthly Keystone leads pull (next Oct 29); content cadence one new guide plus one refresh a week.

# Standing rules
The 18 numbered rules are summarized in [Pipeliners - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-pipeliners-decisions-and-rules).

# Reporting format
Work-report format (TOPIC, Source: Claude Code, PROBLEM / What was done / Result, one Pending list). EOD opens with "Daily GBP post: Post a photo in GBP". First person, never name Kim, full https links, no bare change codes, report from 2026-08-26 onward. Kim may write in Cebuano; reply in English.
